mapper.select: SELECT FROM knowledge_tag WHERE deleted=0 AND name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') ORDER BY article_count DESC,name ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM knowledge_tag WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM knowledge_tag WHERE name=#{name} AND deleted=0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_tag SET deleted=1,update_by=#{operatorId},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0 AND article_count=0
UPDATE knowledge_tag SET article_count=article_count+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
UPDATE knowledge_tag SET article_count=GREATEST(article_count-1,0) WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
